items.content: Process, pneumatic and electrical hook-up typicals with bill of materials (tubing, fittings, manifolds, supports) and tag-to-hook-up assignment list.

items.name: Wiring, marshalling and termination diagrams
items.content: JB and marshalling cabinet termination diagrams, multicore/single-pair allocation, cable block diagrams, IS/non-IS segregation.

items.name: Instrument cable schedule
items.content: Cable tag, type, cores/pairs, size, from/to (device, JB, cabinet), route segments, length, gland type; for construction pulling and MTO.

items.name: Instrument cable routing and tray loading requirements
items.content: Instrument cable count, overall diameter and weight per tray segment, IS/signal segregation, for ELEC raceway sizing.

items.name: Loop diagrams
items.content: Loop from field device to system channel: terminals, cables, JBs, power, IS parameters, ranges, set points; used for loop checks.

items.name: Instrument bulk MTO
items.content: Quantities and specs of cable by type, tubing, fittings, manifolds, JBs, glands, supports, with surplus, for requisition and Jovix material control.

items.name: Telecom system design
items.content: PA/GA, CCTV, LAN/WAN, radio and access control specifications, block diagrams and requisition data.

items.name: Telecom device list, locations and power
items.content: Speaker, beacon, camera, access point and reader tags with locations, mounting, power/UPS load and cabling needs.

items.name: System configuration database
items.content: Tag, description, range, units, alarm limits and priorities, I/O assignment, control module typical, for DCS/SIS/F&G configuration (spreadsheet export to vendor tools).

items.name: FAT report and punch list
items.content: FAT test record, punch items by category, configuration changes required, release for shipment.

items.name: I&C RFI responses and field changes
items.content: RFI answers, field change instructions with revised hook-up, routing or termination details.

items.name: Instrument tag register for completions
items.content: Instrument, cable, JB and loop tags with type, system, subsystem, ITR form type, for spreadsheet load into Smart Completions.

items.name: I&C punch and loop check resolutions
items.content: Engineering responses to loop check failures and punch items, range/set point corrections.

items.name: SAT and SIS validation records and as-configured database
items.content: SAT results, SIF validation records, final as-configured database backup and change log.

items.name: As-built I&C database and drawings
items.content: As-built instrument index, datasheets, loops, wiring and location drawings for owner handover.

items.name: Instrumentation deliverables list
items.content: Index, datasheets, loops, C&E and layouts with planned dates.

items.name: Instrumentation progress measurement
items.content: Datasheet and loop diagram completion counts against plan.

items.name: Instrumentation holds
items.content: Loops and datasheets on hold awaiting vendor or other discipline data, with cause.

items.name: Electrical communication FAT setup
items.content: DCS/ECMS emulator or test rig and communication map for the integrated switchgear/MCC communication test.

items.name: Agreed final relief valve sizing for purchase
items.content: Per PSV: final orifice, model, set pressure, rated capacity, inlet and outlet sizes and ratings, agreed by I&C, Process and vendor.
